1 // bin/live-round-agent.mjs — Wave W5 LIVE CROSS-FAMILY ROUND AGENT (the 5:1 verification split).
2 //
3 // THE MISSING SEAM. bin/round.mjs's `orchestrateRound` takes an INJECTED `agent(prompt, opts)` and
4 // dispatches its adjudication roles (reviewer / debate / judge / synthesizer) through it. Until now the
5 // only live wiring (run-ramanujan-round.mjs) replayed a SINGLE-family Claude stub and HARD-CODED
6 // `substrateFamilies: ['claude']` — so a run could never honestly reach a second family, and the
7 // suspiciously-dry guard (assessConvergenceHonesty) + the deliverable's `cross_model` proxy were fed a
8 // fabricated substrate list. This module is that missing wiring: it builds the round's live `agent` via
9 // the trio's `makeRoleRoutedAgent` so the VERIFICATION roles route to a real cross-family (Gemini `agy
10 // -p`) seat while the drafter/synthesizer/default stay on Claude — the machine-wide 5:1 split — and it
11 // DERIVES `substrateFamilies` from the families ACTUALLY REACHED, never a hard-coded list.
12 //
13 // Reference topology proven live in Gandalf W3 (skills/gandalf/runtime/live-refuter.mjs): Claude drafts,
14 // Gemini verifies; the verification role MUST resolve to a NON-drafter family (never self-review), and if
15 // the cross-family backend is unavailable the W0 gemini-cli seam throws HaltError (non-attested /
16 // substituted) so the round HALTs honestly instead of silently self-reviewing on Claude.
17 //
18 // THE FOUR LOAD-BEARING BEHAVIORS (build task W5):
19 //   1. ROLE-ROUTED AGENT via makeRoleRoutedAgent — reviewer/shark/debate/judge → gemini-cli (model
20 //      resolved by TRIO_TIER in the driver ladder), synthesizer/default → claude. The injected-agent
21 //      SEAM is preserved: instrumentRoundAgent wraps ANY agent (a stub in tests, the live role-routed
22 //      agent in production), so no live call is required to exercise the tracking + cap logic.
23 //   2. substrateFamilies FROM REACHED BACKENDS — a per-run tracker records the distinct family of every
24 //      dispatch that ACTUALLY RETURNED (attested). A run that genuinely reaches a Gemini reviewer/judge
25 //      reports ['claude','gemini']; a Gemini-absent (single-family) run honestly reports ['claude'].
26 //   3. CONCURRENCY CAP — a counting semaphore bounds concurrent LIVE-GEMINI (agy) dispatches to
27 //      RESEARCHPRIME_GEMINI_MAX_CONCURRENCY (default 2, hard ceiling 3: agy OOMs above ~3 concurrent).
28 //      Only gemini-family calls are gated; Claude dispatches run unbounded.
29 //   4. HONEST DEGRADE — a failed/unattested Gemini call throws (the W0 seam's HaltError-on-non-attested)
30 //      and is NOT recorded as reached and NOT retried onto Claude; it propagates so the round HALTs. The
31 //      routing guard additionally refuses to even BUILD an agent whose verification role would resolve to
32 //      the drafter family (fail-closed against self-review).
33 //
34 // Stdlib + the shipped researchPrime/trio seams only. The trio role-routed agent is a LAZY dynamic import
35 // (live path only), so importing THIS module never loads the trio and never spawns a subprocess — the
36 // deterministic test injects a stub agent and exercises the full routing / tracking / cap path with zero
37 // live calls.

73 /** The SINGLE-FAMILY (replay / degraded) route table: every role → Claude. Used by the offline replay
74  *  runner so its `substrateFamilies` is DERIVED (['claude']) from the reached backend, not hard-coded. */
75 export const SINGLE_FAMILY_ROUTES = Object.freeze({ default: { driver: 'claude' } });
76 
77 /** The env var + safe default + hard ceiling for the live-Gemini concurrency cap. agy OOMs above ~3
78  *  concurrent `agy -p` children, so the ceiling is 3 and the default is a conservative 2. */
79 export const GEMINI_CAP_ENV = 'RESEARCHPRIME_GEMINI_MAX_CONCURRENCY';
80 export const DEFAULT_GEMINI_CAP = 2;
81 export const MAX_GEMINI_CAP = 3;
82 
83 /** Thrown when a VERIFICATION role would resolve to the DRAFTER family (self-review). A named HaltError
84  *  subclass so the engine treats it as a HALT-for-human and the caller/test can assert the run HALTs
85  *  rather than silently self-reviewing on the drafter's own model (which earns no cross-family origin). */
86 export class SelfReviewHalt extends HaltError {
87   constructor(role, resolvedFamily, drafterFamily, driver) {
88     super(
89       `self-review HALT: verification role ${JSON.stringify(role)} resolves to driver ${JSON.stringify(driver)} ` +
90         `(family ${JSON.stringify(resolvedFamily)}) which is the DRAFTER family ${JSON.stringify(drafterFamily)} — ` +
91         `a verification seat MUST resolve to a NON-drafter family (never self-review).`,
92       `route ${JSON.stringify(role)} to a cross-family backend (e.g. driver 'gemini-cli') or fix routes.default.`,
93     );
94     this.name = 'SelfReviewHalt';
95     this.role = role;
96     this.resolved_family = resolvedFamily;
97     this.drafter_family = drafterFamily;
98     this.driver = driver;
99   }
100 }
101 
102 /** Map a trio driver name to its model FAMILY (the leading token — STRICT prefix, never a substring, so a
103  *  label like 'claude-…-gemini-fallback' stamps claude, not gemini). Returns null for an empty/unknown
104  *  driver so the routing guard fails CLOSED (an unverifiable family is treated as unsafe). */
105 export function familyFromDriver(driver) {
106   const t = String(driver ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
107   if (!t) return null;
108   if (t.startsWith('gemini')) return 'gemini';
109   if (t.startsWith('claude')) return 'claude';
110   if (t.startsWith('openai') || t.startsWith('gpt')) return 'openai';
111   if (t.startsWith('grok')) return 'grok';
112   return t.split(/[\s\-_]/)[0] || null;
113 }
114 
115 /** The role KEY for an `agent(prompt, opts)` call — identical resolution to makeRoleRoutedAgent: `opts.role`
116  *  else the label prefix before ':' / '#' / '.' / whitespace, lowercased. */
117 export function resolveRoleKey(opts = {}) {
118   return String(opts.role || opts.label || '').split(/[:#.\s]/)[0].toLowerCase();
119 }
120 
121 /** The FAMILY a given role resolves to under a route table (route[role] else route.default), via
122  *  familyFromDriver. Mirrors makeRoleRoutedAgent's own selection so the wrapper's bookkeeping matches the
123  *  backend actually chosen. Returns null when neither the role nor default names a resolvable driver. */
124 export function familyFromRoute(routes = {}, role = '') {
125   const route = routes[role] || routes.default || {};
126   return familyFromDriver(route.driver || null);
127 }
128 
129 /**
130  * ROUTING GUARD (behavior 4, fail-closed). Assert EVERY verification role resolves to a NON-drafter
131  * family under `routes`. HALTs (SelfReviewHalt) the moment any verification seat would resolve to the
132  * drafter family OR to an unverifiable/empty driver — so a self-review agent can never even be built.
133  * @param {{routes?:object, drafterFamily?:string, roles?:string[]}} [o]
134  * @returns {Object<string,string>} role → resolved cross-family, on pass
135  */
136 export function assertCrossFamilyRouting({ routes = {}, drafterFamily = DRAFTER_FAMILY, roles = VERIFICATION_ROLES } = {}) {
137   const drafter = String(drafterFamily ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
138   const resolved = {};
139   for (const role of roles) {
140     const route = routes[role] || routes.default || {};
141     const driver = route.driver || null;
142     const family = familyFromDriver(driver);
143     if (!family || family === drafter) {
144       throw new SelfReviewHalt(role, family, drafter, driver);
145     }
146     resolved[role] = family;
147   }
148   return resolved;
149 }
150 
151 /** Resolve the live-Gemini concurrency cap: `RESEARCHPRIME_GEMINI_MAX_CONCURRENCY` clamped to [1, 3]
152  *  (agy OOMs above ~3), default 2. A non-integer / out-of-range env value falls back to the default. */
153 export function resolveGeminiCap(env = process.env) {
154   const raw = Number.parseInt(env[GEMINI_CAP_ENV], 10);
155   if (!Number.isInteger(raw) || raw < 1) return DEFAULT_GEMINI_CAP;
156   return Math.min(raw, MAX_GEMINI_CAP);
157 }
158 
159 /**
160  * A minimal in-process counting semaphore (behavior 3). `acquire()` resolves once a slot is free (FIFO
161  * for waiters); `release()` frees a slot and admits the next waiter. No timers, no I/O — purely
162  * deterministic, so the concurrency cap is testable without any real subprocess.
163  * @param {number} max  slots (integer >= 1)
164  */
165 export function makeSemaphore(max) {
166   if (!Number.isInteger(max) || max < 1) {
167     throw new TypeError('makeSemaphore(max): max must be an integer >= 1');
168   }
169   let active = 0;
170   const waiters = [];
171   return {
172     acquire() {
173       return new Promise((resolve) => {
174         if (active < max) { active += 1; resolve(); }
175         else waiters.push(resolve);
176       });
177     },
178     release() {
179       if (active <= 0) return;
180       const next = waiters.shift();
181       if (next) next(); // hand the just-freed slot straight to the next waiter (active unchanged)
182       else active -= 1;
183     },
184     get active() { return active; },
185     get max() { return max; },
186   };
187 }
188 
189 /**
190  * A per-run REACHED-FAMILY tracker (behavior 2). Records the distinct model families that ACTUALLY ran
191  * (an agent dispatch that returned attested). `families()` is the honest `substrateFamilies` the round /
192  * deliverable / suspiciously-dry guard consume — never a hard-coded list.
193  * @param {Iterable<string>} [seed=[]]  optional pre-seeded families (e.g. a known drafter)
194  */
195 export function makeReachedFamilyTracker(seed = []) {
196   const reached = new Set();
197   const add = (f) => { if (f) reached.add(String(f).trim().toLowerCase()); };
198   for (const f of seed || []) add(f);
199   return {
200     note(family) { add(family); },
201     families() { return [...reached].sort(); },
202     has(family) { return reached.has(String(family ?? '').trim().toLowerCase()); },
203     get size() { return reached.size; },
204   };
205 }
206 
207 /**
208  * Wrap ANY injected `agent(prompt, opts)` so that, per dispatch:
209  *   • the call's role → family is resolved from `routes` (matching makeRoleRoutedAgent's own choice);
210  *   • a GEMINI-family call acquires a slot from the shared gemini semaphore BEFORE dispatch and releases
211  *     it after (the concurrency cap — behavior 3); Claude calls are ungated;
212  *   • on a SUCCESSFUL return the family is recorded as REACHED (behavior 2). A THROW (the W0 seam's
213  *     HaltError on a non-attested / down Gemini) is NEVER recorded and NEVER caught — it propagates so the
214  *     round HALTs honestly, and the slot is released in `finally` (behavior 4).
215  *
216  * This is the injected-agent SEAM: `agent` can be a deterministic stub (tests) or the live role-routed
217  * agent (production). Nothing here spawns a process.
218  *
219  * @param {object} o
220  * @param {Function} o.agent                       the underlying agent(prompt, opts) (stub or live)
221  * @param {object}   [o.routes=DEFAULT_ROUND_ROUTES]
222  * @param {object}   o.tracker                      a makeReachedFamilyTracker()
223  * @param {object}   [o.geminiSemaphore]            a makeSemaphore(cap); built from o.geminiCap if omitted
224  * @param {number}   [o.geminiCap]                  cap for the internally-built semaphore
225  * @returns {(prompt:string, opts?:object)=>Promise<any>}
226  */
227 export function instrumentRoundAgent({
228   agent,
229   routes = DEFAULT_ROUND_ROUTES,
230   tracker,
231   geminiSemaphore = null,
232   geminiCap,
233 } = {}) {
234   if (typeof agent !== 'function') {
235     throw new TypeError('instrumentRoundAgent: an injected agent(prompt, opts) is required');
236   }
237   if (!tracker || typeof tracker.note !== 'function' || typeof tracker.families !== 'function') {
238     throw new TypeError('instrumentRoundAgent: a reached-family tracker (makeReachedFamilyTracker()) is required');
239   }
240   const sem = geminiSemaphore
241     || makeSemaphore(Number.isInteger(geminiCap) && geminiCap >= 1 ? Math.min(geminiCap, MAX_GEMINI_CAP) : DEFAULT_GEMINI_CAP);
242 
243   return async (prompt, opts = {}) => {
244     const role = resolveRoleKey(opts);
245     const family = familyFromRoute(routes, role);
246     const gated = family === 'gemini';
247     if (gated) await sem.acquire();
248     try {
249       const out = await agent(prompt, opts);
250       // Reached ONLY on a successful (attested) return — a thrown HaltError below is never recorded, so a
251       // failed/unavailable Gemini call can never inflate substrateFamilies (honest degrade).
252       tracker.note(family);
253       return out;
254     } finally {
255       if (gated) sem.release();
256     }
257   };
258 }
259 
260 /**
261  * Build the LIVE role-routed round agent from coding/review family prefs
262  * (reviewer/shark/debate/judge → REVIEW_FAMILY, synthesizer/default → CODING_FAMILY).
263  * Omit `routes` to honor prefs; pass an explicit table to pin. Instrumented with the
264  * reached-family tracker + live-Gemini concurrency cap. LAZY dynamic import of the trio
265  * registry. Runs the routing guard FIRST so a self-review route can never be built.
266  * @param {object} o
267  * @param {object}   [o.routes]                     omit → prefs; pass to pin
268  * @param {object}   o.tracker                      a makeReachedFamilyTracker() (its families() become substrateFamilies)
269  * @param {string}   [o.drafterFamily]              omit → CODING_FAMILY from prefs
270  * @param {object}   [o.env=process.env]
271  * @param {number}   [o.geminiCap]                  override the env-resolved cap
272  * @param {string}   [o.target]                     cwd / edit scope threaded to the backend
273  * @param {Function} [o.log]
274  * @returns {Promise<(prompt:string, opts?:object)=>Promise<any>>}
275  */
276 export async function buildLiveRoundAgent({
277   routes,
278   tracker,
279   drafterFamily,
280   env = process.env,
281   geminiCap,
282   target,
283   log,
284 } = {}) {
285   if (!tracker) throw new TypeError('buildLiveRoundAgent: a reached-family tracker is required (its families() → substrateFamilies)');
286   const { makeRoleRoutedAgent, buildRoutesFromFamilies } = await import('../../drivers/index.mjs');
287   const built = buildRoutesFromFamilies({
288     env,
289     codingRoles: ['synthesizer'],
290     reviewRoles: ['reviewer', 'shark', 'debate', 'judge'],
291   });
292   const resolvedRoutes = routes ?? built.routes;
293   const resolvedDrafter = drafterFamily ?? built.drafterFamily;
294   // Fail-closed against accidental self-review, unless Anchor prefs set
295   // coding_family === review_family (honest single-family; cross_model:false).
296   const singleFamilyPrefs = !routes && built.families.coding === built.families.review;
297   if (!singleFamilyPrefs) {
298     assertCrossFamilyRouting({ routes: resolvedRoutes, drafterFamily: resolvedDrafter });
299   }
300   const cap = Number.isInteger(geminiCap) ? Math.min(geminiCap, MAX_GEMINI_CAP) : resolveGeminiCap(env);
301   const routed = makeRoleRoutedAgent({
302     routes: resolvedRoutes,
303     env: { ...env, CRUCIBLE_AGENT_LIVE: '1' },
304     ...(target !== undefined ? { target } : {}),
305     ...(log !== undefined ? { log } : {}),
306   });
307   return instrumentRoundAgent({ agent: routed, routes: resolvedRoutes, tracker, geminiCap: cap });
308 }
